retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style outdoor portrait featuring a subject in a light blazer and hat leaning against a vintage car with geometric, lowercase typography.
triggerTerms: vintage car portrait with geometric sans

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a tan blazer and fedora leaning against a dark vintage convertible, set against a backdrop of rolling hills and a clear blue sky, framed by a thin dark border and featuring right-aligned geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a car in the left two-thirds of the frame
Typography positioned in the upper right quadrant
Warm earth tones of the clothing contrasting with the cool blue sky
Horizontal line of the car hood leading the eye toward the background hills
coreInvariants: Thin dark blue outer border framing the entire composition
Geometric lowercase sans-serif typography with a horizontal rule
Natural, warm daylight with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-full shot, positioned on the left, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's tan blazer and light-colored hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the blazer to the car, then across to the text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right sky area to accommodate the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and tan (blazer/hat) create a classic complementary-adjacent palette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark navy or black of the car and the outer border provide structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow-white of the typography and the highlights on the car chrome.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation typical of 1970s film stock with high value in the sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to natural earth tones and sky blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular counters and uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a closed loop tail
The 'a' is a single-story geometric construction
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both lines, separated by a thin horizontal rule.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal line separating the two lines of text
Thin dark blue border around the entire image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, rounded, and lowercase aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and circular counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a tan blazer and fedora leaning against a vintage black convertible in a hilly landscape under a clear blue sky. Add a thin dark blue border around the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned, lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper right sky area, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is there a horizontal line between the text rows?
Is the subject leaning against a car on the left side?
Is there a thin dark border around the entire image?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the horizontal rule in the text block
Ensure the subject is positioned off-center to the left
Confirm the presence of the thin outer border
Check that the color palette remains in the warm/natural range
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Portrait + Geometric Sans + Right-Aligned Layout + Natural Landscape
